name: compdf-convert-images-to-documents
tagline_zh: 截图、扫描件、收据、表单，拍张照就能变成可编辑的Word、Excel或PPT。支持9种格式，连JSON都能转。
tagline_en: Turn screenshots, scans, receipts, and forms into editable Word, Excel, PPT, or even JSON. 9 formats, one snap.
desc_en: Convert image files into Word, Excel, PPT, PDF, HTML, RTF, CSV, TXT, or JSON with ComPDF. Use for screenshots, scans, receipts, forms, and photo-based business documents that need editable or structured output.
why_zh: 不止转PDF，直接输出结构化JSON或CSV，让表格和表单数据可编程调用，省掉二次清洗。
why_en: Goes beyond PDF—outputs structured JSON/CSV, making table and form data programmatically usable, no extra cleanup.
